image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of Fiscal 2026, detailing reported IFRS financial measures alongside adjusted non-IFRS figures. Key metrics include operating profit, net profit, and earnings per share (EPS) for both nine-month and three-month periods ending December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024. The data highlights a year-over-year revenue growth of 8.9% and a slight decline in operating margin percentage. Notably, the net profit for the three months ended December 31, 2025, is reported at ₹6,654 crore, reflecting a decrease compared to the previous year. The document also includes adjustments for labor codes, providing a comprehensive view of the financial performance.
